findings.rationale: The materialized filename is keyed only by source stem and process ID. Reentrant or concurrent materializations of the same Markdown source within one process therefore write the same file, and dropping either LiterateState removes the file still referenced by the other. std::fs::write also replaces or follows any pre-existing predictable path instead of atomically claiming a unique file.

unparsed_clauses emits every statistical-property failure before every observed-property failure because it chains two type-grouped collections. It does not preserve declaration source order as the caller assumes, so parse_checked_ai_project can report the location of a later statistical clause instead of the first offending clause in the file.
